note: A session on ${CONSOLE} takes the console over until 'quit'. The REPL prompt is '>>> ', not the console's, so inputs are written ('write') and answers awaited in the log; every print is labelled. Integer arithmetic only: float parsing and printing are broken on MAiXDUiNO_K210. 50000 bytes of workspace; Pico2's RISC-V heap could not give 90000.

tests.note: start, two evaluations, quit, and the console must be back

then.write: print('P_gc', sum(len(str(i)*20) for i in range(3000)))

tests.note: 217800 bytes of short-lived strings in a 50000-byte workspace force several collections while a generator is running. gc_collect() used to take oStack for the top of the stack, traced almost nothing and freed live objects: a BusFault at the first collection (fixed, ../DEFECTS.md)

then.write: def p(n): print('P_d', n, 1.5); return p(n+1)

tests.note: unbounded recursion must end in an exception, not in the kernel's 'stack underflow' halt. The second function prints a float from every frame, so the deepest one runs the whole print chain below the last stack check: that is what MICROPY_STACK_CHECK_MARGIN has to cover (../DEFECTS.md)

a one-character line is evaluated, a line that merely starts like 'quit' is Python (a NameError here), and only 'quit' ends the session. The quit test used to compare only the first strlen-1 characters, so '7', 'q' and 'qx' all ended it (fixed, ../DEFECTS.md)
